Game rules

Step 1
Choose a map
Number of human players (taking turns on one device)
Total tribes in the world (the rest are bots)
Time limit
If time runs out, the tribe with the most territory wins.
How often you are asked to make decisions
Game mode
Casual: advisers run the kingdom and you answer the important decisions. Competitive: you choose which territories to attack and where troops go. Competitive on one device is for 1 player only; to play together, use Play online.
Starting location
Spread out: human players start as far apart as possible, with bots in between. Random: starting points are random, so you may start right next to a friend. Every starting point is equally fertile.
🙈 Blind match
Nobody knows who plays which tribe until the game is over. If two players pick the same tribe, it is locked for everyone and both choose again.
